race.comment: ARKUNA (3) is in a purple patch of form having come from wider barriers to win her last two outings, taking her record at this circuit and distance to three from four. Hard to knock and the good draw could see her land the hat trick. Former Kiwi CYAMATE NZ (7) showed improvement in his second local outing when third over this distance at Newcastle last start, beaten 2 metres. Could be ready to deliver. KELLOSHIEL (1) may find this easier than the last attempt and has been good from wider barriers in her previous two outings for a Newcastle win and a placing here. SPIRIT OF ARION NZ (8) draws wide but there was merit in his latest performance for fourth at this circuit and distance.
